treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Malta and the Government of the United States of America for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2008)
eif_quote: that the Convention has entered into force on the 23rd November, 2010.
source_title: S.L. 123.123 Double Taxation Relief (Taxes on Income) (United States of America) Order (Schedule: 2008 Convention)

rates.quote: if the dividends are paid by a company that is a resident of the United States to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, except as otherwise provided in This Convention, the tax charged by the United States shall not exceed: i) 5 percent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company that owns directly at least 10 percent of the voting stock of the company paying the dividends;
ii) 15 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

Such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, hut the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

Such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: n/a - MLI not applicable (United States not a signatory); treaty relies on Art. 22 Limitation on Benefits

notes: Art. 28(2)(a): effective for taxes withheld at source on amounts paid/credited on or after the first day of the second month after EIF (2010-11-23) -> 2011-01-01. US 5% tier: company owning directly >=10% of voting stock, no holding period; not available for RIC/REIT dividends (REIT dividends get 15% only for qualifying small/listed/diversified holders, Art. 10(4)). Dividends to pension funds exempt (Art. 10(3)). Malta-source dividends (Art. 10(2)(b)): Malta tax 'shall not exceed that Malta tax chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid' - no fixed percentage, not modelled. Branch profits tax at 5% (Art. 10(8)). Interest: US contingent interest up to 15%, REMIC excess inclusions taxed under domestic law (Art. 11(3)). Royalties include contingent gains on alienation of IP (Art. 12(3)(b)). Comprehensive Limitation on Benefits (Art. 22). No PPT: United States not an MLI signatory (merged dataset).
